description: This file manages temporary file lifecycle and cleanup, including creation, registration, opening, closing, renaming, deleting, and signal-based cleanup handling. It maintains a linked list of tempfile objects, ensures cleanup on process exit or signals, and maintains consistency of tempfile objects during various states.

classes.name: tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file, including its filename, file descriptor, file pointer, owner PID, associated directory, and node in the linked list.

methods.name: int remove_template_directory(struct tempfile * tempfile,int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile if it exists.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles(int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes all tempfiles in the global list, optionally during a signal handling context.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_exit(void)
methods.description: Calls remove_tempfiles during program exit.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_signal(int signo)
methods.description: Handles cleanup of tempfiles during a signal, then re-raises the signal.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * new_tempfile(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile structure.

methods.name: void activate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Adds the tempfile to the global list and sets its owner.

methods.name: void deactivate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Removes the tempfile from the list, releases resources, and frees memory.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile_mode(const char * path,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with specified mode at a given path.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * register_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Registers an existing filepath as a tempfile in the system.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_sm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tsm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in TMPDIR or /tmp with a filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_dt(const char * directory_template,const char * filename)
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory from a template and a file within it.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file from a filename template and mode, aborts on failure.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile,const char * mode)
methods.description: Converts a tempfile's file descriptor into a FILE* stream.

methods.name: const char * get_tempfile_path(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the filepath of the tempfile.

methods.name: int get_tempfile_fd(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_tempfile_fp(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the FILE* pointer of the tempfile.

methods.name: int close_tempfile_gently(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the tempfile without deleting the actual file.

methods.name: int reopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Reopens a tempfile that was previously closed.

methods.name: int rename_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames the tempfile to a new path, cleaning up previous tempfile state.

methods.name: int delete_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p)
methods.description: Deletes the tempfile, closing files and removing files and directory as needed.

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_sm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_sm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_tsm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/
